info.title: API.SH: Zauba Corp
info.description: The Zauba Corp API from API.SH: public Zauba Corp data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Companies and LLPs registered at an address that matches the query (street, building, area, city or PIN code), with CIN/LLPIN and full registered address. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zaubacorp-address-search

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address text, e.g. a building and area.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 50, max 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The Indian company directory filtered by state, city, PIN code, ROC, status, company type, industry (NIC section), age, paid-up capital band, listing and last balance-sheet date; 30 companies per page with name, CIN, status, registered address and paid-up capital, plus `facets`: every further filter value with its company count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zaubacorp-companies

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State in capitals, e.g. MAHARASHTRA, DELHI, KARNATAKA.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Company status, e.g. Active, Strike Off, Amalgamated, Under liquidation.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City in capitals, e.g. MUMBAI.

parameters.name: pincode
parameters.description: 6-digit PIN code.

parameters.name: roc
parameters.description: Registrar of Companies, e.g. ROC Mumbai.

parameters.name: company_type
parameters.description: PTC private, PLC public, LLP, OPC one-person, NPL not-for-profit, FTC foreign subsidiary, FFF foreign company, GOI central government, SGC state government, GAP, GAT, ULT, ULL, FLC.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: NIC section letter A-Q (e.g. K real estate, renting and business activities; D manufacturing); see `facets.industry`.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: A under 1 year, B 1-3, C 3-5, D 5-10, E 10-25, F over 25 years.

parameters.name: paid_up_capital
parameters.description: A 0-1 lakh, B 1-5 lakh, C 5-25 lakh, D 25 lakh-1 crore, E 1-5 crore, F 5-25 crore, G 25-100 crore, H 100-500 crore, I 500 crore+.

parameters.name: listed
parameters.description: Listed or Unlisted.

parameters.name: balance_sheet_date
parameters.description: Date of the last filed balance sheet, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-03-31).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Indian company or LLP from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs register as Zauba Corp publishes it: name, status, listing, ROC, registration number, category, sub-category, class, incorporation date and age, NIC industry code and description, number of members, last AGM and balance-sheet dates, authorised and paid-up capital (or LLP contribution), previous names and CINs, registered email, website and address, current and past directors and key managerial personnel (DIN, name, designation, appointment and cessation dates) with each director's other directorships, charges (charge id, creation, modification and closure dates, amount, charge holder) and companies at the same address. Financial statements, shareholders and complaint details are sold by Zauba Corp as a paid report and are not included. Unknown CINs answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zaubacorp-company

parameters.name: cin
parameters.description: Company CIN (21 characters), LLPIN (e.g. AAB-7886) or foreign company id, or a zaubacorp.com company URL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One director as the register publishes them: name, DIN, how many companies they are or were associated with, current appointments (company, CIN/LLPIN, designation, appointment date) and past appointments with cessation dates. Look up by DIN (find DINs by name with /zaubacorp/v1/director-search). Unknown DINs answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zaubacorp-director

parameters.name: din
parameters.description: Director Identification Number (8 digits), or a zaubacorp.com director URL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Search Indian company directors by name
get.description:
Directors whose name matches, as the register publishes them: name, DIN and the company each listed appointment is with (name, CIN, link). Open one with /zaubacorp/v1/director?din=. Up to 100 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zaubacorp-director-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A director's name (at least 3 letters).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 50, max 100).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (from 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
